text: He consulted with no one, yet never got his own way in anything.... those things he does one day he undoes the next, and no one ever understands what he wishes or intends to do, and no one can rely on his resolutions.
author: Niccolo Machiavelli
locator: Chapter XXIII, How flatterers should be avoided
location: Sant'Andrea in Percussina, near Florence, Italy
